description: OKX public REST funding rates for USDT-margined perpetual swaps (BTC-USDT-SWAP, ETH-USDT-SWAP, SOL-USDT-SWAP): settled funding-rate history (/public/funding-rate-history) and the current funding rate (/public/funding-rate)
permission_basis: Public market data served without authentication by OKX public REST endpoints (/public/funding-rate-history, /public/funding-rate), used for research only; raw payloads are not redistributed. OKX Terms of Service reviewed 2026-11-18. This registry entry is an explicit research-use assertion, not a legal determination.
timestamp_basis: Exchange event time: funding settlement times in UTC milliseconds; a settled rate is knowable at its settlement time (00:00 / 08:00 / 16:00 UTC grid).
